## Old Fashioned

<p class="ratio-note">Ratio: 4 parts whiskey to 1 part sweetener</p>

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof of_servings = Inputs.number([1, 24], {value: 1, step: 1, label: "Servings"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
fmt = d3.format(".2~f")
of_whiskey_oz = fmt(of_servings * 2)
of_sweetener_oz = fmt(of_servings * 0.5)
```

### For `{ojs} of_servings` serving(s):

| Ingredient | Amount |
|---|---|
| Whiskey | `{ojs} of_whiskey_oz` oz |
| Simple or maple syrup | `{ojs} of_sweetener_oz` oz |

: Ingredients

<p class="section-title">Steps (per glass)</p>

::: {.steps}
1. Dash bitters into glass (n = 3).
2. Add simple syrup or maple syrup.
3. Add whiskey.
4. Stir for 30 seconds.
5. Dash in additional bitters, if desired.
6. Add a large ice cube.
7. Add _both_ an orange and lemon peel; pinch each peel, skin-side out, over the glass to release the oils.
8. Garnish with a cherry, if desired.
:::

## G&T

<p class="ratio-note">Ratio: 2 parts tonic water to 1 part gin</p>

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof gt_servings = Inputs.number([1, 24], {value: 1, step: 1, label: "Servings"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
gt_gin_oz = fmt(gt_servings * 1)
gt_tonic_oz = fmt(gt_servings * 2)
```

### For `{ojs} gt_servings` serving(s):

| Ingredient | Amount |
|---|---|
| Gin | `{ojs} gt_gin_oz` oz |
| Tonic water | `{ojs} gt_tonic_oz` oz |

: Ingredients

<p class="section-title">Steps (per glass)</p>

::: {.steps}
1. Place large ice cubes in a glass.
2. Pour gin directly onto the ice.
3. Pour tonic water in second.
4. Squeeze in plenty of fresh lime juice.
5. Garnish with a lime peel.
:::

:::
